subject: chopper-gunner-cockpit-1080
purpose: proof that the reference-grounded loop runs end to end on a real committed pair
framing and value-composition agreement of the chopper gunner cockpit at 1920x1080
provenanceNote: This is a TIER 2 set: both images are our own build output, committed to this repository, so there is no licence question and no third-party art anywhere in the loop. It was chosen deliberately as the first subject because the pair is measured, documented and same-camera, which makes a critic's findings checkable by a human against a commit message rather than against a taste.

sources.licence: Own work, this repository. No third-party rights.
sources.evidenceFor: The approved post-fix state of the Chopper Gunner cockpit at 1920x1080: the cockpit frames the whole view instead of stopping mid-screen, and the HUD is reworked to the existing house style. Committed at 02d9058fe2186a5f0eb518fa28c93971084c64eb, 2026-08-31.
notUsableFor: absolute colour calibration - it is a renderer capture, not a photometric measurement
material-class judgement at print distance - it is a gameplay-distance frame
sources.caveats: Our own build output, so it can only ever anchor us to a state we already reached. It is a REGRESSION anchor, not an aspiration anchor. A real-world photograph is what raises the bar; this raises confidence in the harness.

sources.licence: Own work, this repository. No third-party rights.
sources.evidenceFor: The pre-fix state of the same view at the same camera and resolution, retained as the thing the approved state had to improve on. It stands in for a candidate capture so the loop can be exercised without building anything.
usableFor: standing in for a candidate capture in a harness proof
notUsableFor: being shown to a critic as a target - it is the thing being graded, not the bar
sources.caveats: Never allow-list this as a criticTarget. It is the capture side of the pair.

criticTargets.reason: T2 own work: the approved post-fix frame is the state the capture is being measured against, and showing it to a critic carries no licence or trade-dress risk at all.

pairs.camera: same authored camera on both sides; no camera solve needed for this subject
pairs.note: Same camera on both sides is what makes this pair a HARNESS proof rather than a fidelity claim. A reference photograph would not share our camera and its absolute tier-0 numbers would mean much less.

unknowns: Absolute real-world scale is not derivable from either image and is not claimed.

This set cannot raise the visual bar: both sides are our own output. Raising the bar needs a T2 photograph we took or a T3 permissively-licensed one, and that is an owner decision (R2 section 10, open item 2).
Whether the same probe-token receipt survives on the metered OMP/Gemini route is not settled by this set - it was proven here on the local vision route only.
notMatchable: Both images come from the same renderer, so an agreement on colour temperature here is not evidence that the art direction is right - it is evidence that nothing changed the grade.
